 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. German third tier side Rot Weiss Essen will be hoping to spring an alrighty cup surprise as they host RB Leipzig this evening at an atmospheric Stadion an der Hafenstraße.
 With kick-off scheduled for 18:00 CET in just under an hour's time, you can find the confirmed starting lineups for both teams below.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Confirmed Rot Weiss Essen vs. RB Leipzig lineups:
 Rot Weiss Essen (4-2-3-1): Golz – Hofmann, Huning, Alonso, Bouebari – Sietan, Reisig – Kostka, Abiama, Brumme – Pesch
 RB Leipzig (4-3-3): Nyland – Baku, Orban, Lukeba, Raum – Seiwald, Banzuzi, Reitz – Gomis, Rômulo, Maksimovic
